final_draft.note: I couldn't find an approved answer or policy section on data residency, where data is hosted, or whether customers can pick a country. Nothing mentions Switzerland. The closest match is the approved backup answer (answer:0a6447a7-b776-4075-9f99-6a8316a7ca93, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-17). It says production database backups are 'stored in a second region' but doesn't name either region. It doesn't answer the question and shouldn't be taken to mean Swiss-only storage is possible. If anything, data sitting in two regions could make keeping everything in one country harder, but we have no source either way. The live-settings checks don't cover hosting location, so I couldn't verify that either. The answer needs to come from the data residency or infrastructure owner, and should be added as an approved answer.
